verdict.rationale: Dagster provides a well-documented official Python SDK (the dagster package with asset/decorator APIs, dg CLI, create-dagster scaffolding) that AI-native users and coding agents can build against, plus first-party AI tooling like an official skill for coding agents and a Dagster+ MCP server. missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality for AI-agent workflows, and no evidence of a public REST/OpenAPI API alongside the Python SDK.
